definition.title: CFPB complaint portal response clock
definition.summary: For complaints sent through the CFPB portal: respond within the response period; if that response is not final, give the final response within the final-response period.
definition.appliesTo: Companies on the CFPB complaint portal, for complaints received through it. Not a general statutory deadline.
definition.sourceNote: Checked against the CFPB company-process page: 15 calendar days to respond, up to 60 calendar days for a final response.

definition.title: Reg B notice of action taken
definition.summary: Clock from a completed application to the notice of action taken.

definition.title: Customer contact hours (customer's local time)
definition.summary: Calls only between these hours at the customer's location. Applied as a conduct policy to marketing and collections calls.
definition.appliesTo: TCPA: telephone solicitations to residential subscribers. Reg F: debt collectors as defined in 12 CFR 1006.2 (generally third parties, not a creditor collecting its own debt in its own name). Confirm state rules.
definition.sourceNote: Both texts treat calls before 8 a.m. or after 9 p.m. local time as off-limits (TCPA) or presumptively inconvenient (Reg F). Scope differs; see "Applies to".
